notes.title: Update 1.1.5 - "Balance" update
notes.notes:
The “Balance” update brings a mixture of new mechanics and improves the old ones. In addition, some of the monsters have been adjusted and new monsters have been added.

[h2]New upgrades available:[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Mucky Boots” increases movement speed by up to 50%. Can be purchased from Robin in the saloon.
[*] “Sharp Edges” increases the damage dealt by a critical hit by up to 300%. Applies to all weapon types. Can be purchased from Alex in the shop.
[*] “Enlightenment” increases the damage of tricks such as the aura or the card trick. Can be purchased in the casino from “lucky” Luca.
[*] “Magnification” increases the size of projectiles from ranged attacks. Can be purchased from Casey.
[/list]

There are currently 15 upgrades to buy in the various stores. Have fun combining all the different stores for your perfect run.

[h2]Further changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boss monsters now have more life and give more points with higher level.
[*] Above a certain level, a “heavy” horde now appears in addition to the “easy” horde.
[*] New monsters added.
[*] Monsters with a visible axe can now destroy trees.
[*] Your resolution setting is now retained the next time you start the game.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance improved through code optimization
[*] Text errors/translation errors
[/list]

Have fun playing and thank you very much.

notes.title: "Trapper" update 1.1 now live
notes.notes:
Since Periodicity - Hats and scars launched in December 2024, the game did pretty much as I expected. I got feedback, some valuable, some not so much, and I had some ideas left that didn't make it into the game.

So I continued development and here is the patch 1.1. Aside from bug fixes and performance improvements, I added new weapons to let you change up your playstyle. There are also new upgrades in some of the stores to help you on your way.
In terms of UI I tried to optimize the game for Steam Deck while also improving the 1920 x 1080 look and feel. Every vendor has a sign now so that you know which one is in which building. I also overhauled the glossary to show and explain almost all the items. This makes keeping track of items you have and don't have easier. 

I hope you enjoy these changes and give Periodicity - Hats and scars another go. If you have any feedback, please use the community on Steam to let me know.

All the changes:
[list]
[*] Added new hat
[*] Added new tool
[*] Added new trick
[*] Added multiple upgrades to vendors
[*] Added distinct signs for each vendor
[*] Increased icon size for shops
[*] Improved glossary with pagination
[*] Added tabs for highscores
[*] Added new enemies
[*] Enabled Steam internal screenshots (F12)
[*] removed level complete screen when already seen per level
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with dialogs
[*] Fixed an issue with chicken
[*] removed unused assets to decrease installation size
[*] Fixed enemy health for some enemies
[*] Improved stability
[*] Improved translations
[*] Minor bugs
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: New weapon Update
notes.notes:
In Periodicity - Hats and scars you can equip three weapons at the same time. Here I briefly explain how it works and which weapons are available so far.

[h2]Hats[/h2]
Each hat in the game gives you a different weapon. There are currently three hats and the option to go out without a hat. These are almost always long-range attacks.

The classic cowboy hat is the first hat you'll find. It gives you a pistol that shoots an aimed bullet at a nearby enemy. Further bullets are possible. However, these will not be aimed.

The scare crow hat shoots two feathers at the same time. More feathers can be added to make it easier to hit opponents.

The bowler is a classic. It gives you a shotgun that doesn't shoot as far, but has a wider spread.

[h2]Tools[/h2]
Tools help you to loot materials so that you can rebuild the village. These are mostly melee attacks that can be upgraded.

The axe can chop down trees to bring you wood. It strikes both trees and enemies in circles around you. Unfortunately, it breaks immediately when it hits any monster. However, there are upgrades to change this.

The pickaxe can smash rocks and therefore brings you stones. It always strikes in the direction of travel, so your positioning is very important.

The shovel pierces the ground in front of you at high speed and can uncover monster materials. It attacks in the direction of travel, so positioning is also very important here.

[h2]Tricks[/h2]
Tricks are the last type of weapon. These are almost always medium range attacks or area attacks.

The aura is an area attack that pulses around you every few seconds and can hit all enemies. With the right upgrades and a bit of luck, the aura can become very powerful.

The card trick create individual cards that fly around you and injure opponents who touch them. After an upgrade, the cards are reshuffled.

Many more weapons, tools and tricks are planned.
